name: Kurenai Sarutobi
source:
Kurenai Sarutobi is a kunoichi of Konohagakure's Sarutobi clan. Kurenai is a fair-skinned woman of slender build. She has long black untamed hair reaching her upper back, and very unique eyes that are red in colour, with an additional ring in them. Kurenai is a genjutsu prodigy and is considered Konoha's number one genjutsu user. Kurenai has shown quick reaction speed, able to defend against Itachi's attack after just recently breaking out of her own reflected genjutsu. Her hobby is having evening drinks.
